 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full, uniform lines act as separators between repeated panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_panels = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1])
                  for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1) if row_bounds[i + 1] > row_bounds[i] + 1]
    col_panels = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1])
                  for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1) if col_bounds[i + 1] > col_bounds[i] + 1]
    # The repeated motif is the panel with the most cells unlike the background.
    from collections import Counter
    sep_cells = {(r, c) for r in sep_rows for c in range(w)} | {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in sep_cols}
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if (r, c) not in sep_cells)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    panels = [(r0, r1, c0, c1)
              for r0, r1 in row_panels for c0, c1 in col_panels]
    source = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(
        grid[r][c] != background
        for r in range(p[0], p[1]) for c in range(p[2], p[3])))
    sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1 = source
    motif = [row[sc0:sc1] for row in grid[sr0:sr1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in panels:
        if (r0, r1, c0, c1) == source:
            continue
        if r1 - r0 == len(motif) and c1 - c0 == len(motif[0]):
            for dr in range(r1 - r0):
                out[r0 + dr][c0:c1] = motif[dr][:]
    return out
"
